subject.title: Cron running_at_ms not cleared after agentTurn run

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81572 as the canonical fix path for this latest-release `agentTurn` stale `running_at_ms` report, or require a narrower live repro first?
rationale: Current source shows a credible stale-marker class and the open PR has live proof for that class, but this issue describes a single scheduled cron and does not yet have live current-main reproduction.

options.title: Review linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use the existing incremental outcome persistence PR as the candidate fix and require it to add or confirm coverage for this issue's scheduled isolated `agentTurn` SQLite state.

options.title: Require live single-job repro first
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on live reproduction before accepting the linked PR as covering this exact report.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Use the existing incremental outcome persistence PR as the candidate fix and require it to add or confirm coverage for this issue's scheduled isolated `agentTurn` SQLite state.
